evidence_type: source-analysis explanation confirmed by isolated old-development reproduction
sequence: Engine.runtime retains the previous environment after env.close().
New environment reset renders a valid initial image in its new GL context.
Engine.set_episode replaces old runtime; delayed old MuJoCo renderer destruction occurs after the new context is current.
Unpatched OffScreenViewer.free releases only EGL and leaves its MuJoCo render context to later destruction.
CPU reproduction with the same retained Runtime reference yields all-black observations after the first action of subsequent environments.
repair: Explicit con.free in its own still-current context before EGL free, idempotent cleanup, bind current context for every render; reject black RGB.
comparison_scope: This defect is established for the B E1 legacy resident-engine path. Smol/X standalone workers do not retain Engine.runtime across task changes, and their completed outputs are not automatically reclassified by this diagnosis.
cost: No extra simulator/GPU operations; source analysis only
